baseline: Each native host call allocates its arguments, scans the capabilities and compares platform service names; prints format with snprintf
candidate: Routes are resolved once per instance, up to eight arguments stay on the stack, and integer prints are formatted directly
methodology: Physical Alpha. The site in-process ZX runner (-DMATRIX_ZX_UNBOUNDED) built from each revision on the same example bundles, 7 alternating rounds, results checked; native and engine printed identical bytes for every example. Standard: standard-ab, CPU 3, 5 rounds, C digest checked.

examples.unit: µs per call, median of each run's 11 batch medians
